name: cybertron
description: Cybertron — red/blue-team cybersecurity agent, one runtime, packaged for Windows/macOS/Linux.

scripts.dev:runtime: npm run build --workspace=@cybertron/shared && npm run dev --workspace=runtime
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cybertron/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win --workspace=electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac --workspace=electron
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux --workspace=electron
